_comment: Postman environment for the marsAI backend API.
1. Import this file into Postman via Environments → Import.
2. Set 'baseUrl' to your local server (default: http://localhost:3000).
3. After a successful POST /auth/login, copy the returned token
into the 'authToken' variable so that authenticated requests
are pre-filled with the Authorization header.
The placeholder values below are intentionally empty or fake.
name: marsAI – Local

values._comment: Base URL of the backend server (Express). Change port if needed.
JWT returned by POST /auth/login. Paste it here after logging in.
Email used for the login request body. Replace with a real test account.
Password for the login request. Never commit a real value here.
